PRICE CHALLENGES AND OVERRIDES > 5.2 Overrides","quote":"Any override of a vendor price, broker quote or model value used by the Administrator requires the written approval of the Chief Financial Officer and one other voting member of the Committee. The request must state the reason for the override, the proposed price, its source and the effect on net asset value. The Chief Investment Officer and members of the investment team may not approve an override."}
